description: Source code implementing CAST encryption algorithms, including ECB and CBC modes, key setup, and cipher definitions, as part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: CAST_ecb_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a block of data in ECB mode using CAST cipher.

methods.name: CAST_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CAST encryption on a 64-bit block.

methods.name: CAST_decrypt
methods.description: Performs CAST decryption on a 64-bit block.

methods.name: CAST_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts data in CBC mode using CAST cipher.

methods.name: CAST_set_key
methods.description: Initializes the CAST_KEY structure with the provided key data.

methods.name: CAST_cfb64_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CAST encryption/decryption in 64-bit CFB mode.

methods.name: cast_init_key
methods.description: Initializes the cipher context with the CAST key.

methods.name: cast_ecb_cipher
methods.description: Performs ECB mode encryption/decryption using EVP interface.

methods.name: cast_cbc_cipher
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption/decryption using EVP interface.
